results.summary: The catalog's version rule, refusal path and hook-side parity claim match the resolver and rule engine; the playbook's plugin-disable claim matches the --pure removal.
Every AC row in 001/002/003 reproduces on the merged tree; the three ADR-001 replacement commands return 0; CI run 44632438229 is success on 06d02096e90; two P2 documentation defects recorded.
Feature-catalog version-dispatch and dispatch-authorization entries describe only behaviour the merged code has.
The cli-opencode playbook no longer assumes a v1 runner argument or the plugin-disable flag; its claims match the merged capability surface.

noveltyJustification: Two new P2s against three carried P2s give a weighted-new share of 2/5 = 0.40. Most of the iteration re-proved existing criteria rather than discovering defects: every phase-001 and phase-002 zero-match command, the three 003 replacement checks, the justified-list sweep and the CI run all reproduced, so the ratio reflects the small weighted delta of documentation residue, not thin coverage.
